description: Price a cart the UCP way: pass cart with line_items, and optionally request_id, function_id, routing_preference, currency, stage (quote, cart, checkout or order), checkout, order, payment, context and agentid_token. It routes the cart through the pricing network and answers a UCP quote. Pass agentid_token (an AgentID ID token issued for Last Price) to be recorded as a verified buying agent; the answer then names you, marked verified. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agentid_token.description: Optional: your AgentID ID token (from auth.agentid.com, issued for Last Price), sent as the AgentID-Token header so the quote records you as a verified buying agent. Leave it out to buy unverified.

context.description: Anything that shapes the price: product type, country, channel.

routing_preference.description: How to pick a function when none is named.

stage.description: Where in the funnel the quote is for. Defaults to quote.

name: get_ucp_quote
